# PolyPrompt

> PolyPrompt 4.0 is a .NET 8/10 library with one client per LLM provider (OpenAiClient, OpenAiCompatibleClient, AzureOpenAiClient, XAiClient, AnthropicClient, GeminiClient, VertexAiClient, BedrockClient, OllamaClient, OllamaCloudClient, CohereClient, VoyageAiClient, TeiClient, TypeSafeClient). Every client exposes every operation through ProviderClientBase; unsupported operations throw CapabilityNotSupportedException, so check client.Supports(Capability.X) first. It also drives local agent harness CLIs (ClaudeCodeClient, CodexClient, GeminiCliClient, CursorClient, MuxClient, PiClient, OpenCodeClient).

Read these first:

- [For coding agents](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt#for-coding-agents): constructors per provider, the operation list, the capability rule, the options-type rule, models, errors, and continuation state.
- [Capability matrix](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt#capability-matrix): which client supports which capability (machine-checked against the code).
- [Which OpenAI client?](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt#which-openai-client): OpenAiClient (Responses API) versus OpenAiCompatibleClient (Chat Completions: vLLM, Ollama /v1, LM Studio, gateways).
- [Default models](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt#default-models): per client and defaults section; "none" means set Defaults.<Section>.Model.
- [MIGRATION_V3_TO_V4.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/MIGRATION_V3_TO_V4.md): every 3.x to 4.0 rename in one table, behavior changes, and a checklist.

Key rules:

- Set models with client.Defaults.Completion.Model (also .Embedding, .Rerank, .Classification, .Decision, .SparseEmbedding) or per call; there is no client.Model.
- Pass the base options type (CompletionOptions, EmbeddingOptions, ...) or the client's own options type; another provider's options type throws ArgumentException.
- HTTP errors return Success = false with StatusCode and Error; they do not throw. Enumerate streams fully and require State == StreamingState.Completed.
- After a tool-chat turn, append response.ToAssistantMessage() unchanged (it carries ProviderState), then ChatMessage.ToolResult(call.Id, call.Name, result) per call.

Optional:

- [PROVIDERS.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/PROVIDERS.md): constructors, auth, per-provider behavior, Responses API, Gemini tool calling, reasoning-effort mapping, citations, options classes.
- [HARNESSES.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/HARNESSES.md): agent harness setup, permissions, requests and results.
- [STREAMING.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/STREAMING.md): streaming lifecycle and Responses API events.
- [TELEMETRY.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/TELEMETRY.md): metrics and traces.
- [AOT.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/AOT.md): Native AOT and source-generated JSON.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jchristn/Polyprompt/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
